title: Paperclip scientists work on the Magenta craft

tellings.quote: Many of the top Nazi scientists as a part of Operation Paperclip that the Allies had exfiltrated also made their way to Wright Patterson to work on the magenta craft.

plain: After the war, some of the top German scientists who had worked for the Nazis were brought to Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Dayton, Ohio, and put to work on the craft said to have crashed at Magenta in Italy. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, tying it to Operation Paperclip, the postwar program that brought German scientists to the United States. If true, the first American study of such a craft would have leaned on German expertise.
